title: Repair canonical review publication and exact-version GitHub gate

owned: Exact Git target commit validation in canonical_review_gate_ci.py via bounded tag peeling (up to depth 5), rejecting mismatched commits, non-commit objects, and malformed tags.
Observable workflow_dispatch in github_review_bridge.py defaulting to required=True on both APPROVE and REOPEN decisions.

Retirement of legacy direct PAT status submission (_submit_required_status) in github_review_bridge.py so github-actions[bot] remains the sole authoritative status issuer for 'Pantheon canonical review gate'.
Bridge-side deletion of opposing decision tags on approve, operator_accept, and reopen decisions to prevent conflicting proof tags.
Fail-closed evaluation in canonical_review_gate_ci.py when a reopen tag or conflicting tags exist for the target commit.

Canonical review gate reconciliation in auto_integrator.py: re-dispatching review gate workflow when TaskStore approval and GitHub proof tag are valid, waiting without blocking independent candidates; substantive test failures fail closed immediately.
not_changing: TaskStore canonical approval authority, state machine, or review locks.
External signed attestation audit issuer architecture or diagnostic contracts.
No second mechanisms, queues, background daemons, or alternate approval APIs introduced.
composes_with: the existing per-task PR review/merge flow and supervisor integration runner

failure_reproduction.case_1_tag_target_commit: canonical_review_gate_ci previously checked only ref name presence, accepting tags pointing to wrong commits or non-commit objects.
failure_reproduction.case_2_swallowed_dispatch: github_review_bridge previously caught and swallowed workflow_dispatch failures when required=False, leaving PRs red without observable errors while posting conflicting PAT status.
failure_reproduction.case_3_reopen_approve_conflict: Reopening an approved candidate on the same commit left both approved and reopen tags; gate checked only approved tag and reported false green.
failure_reproduction.case_4_integrator_stagnation: auto_integrator had no way to reconcile a red/pending review gate check when TaskStore approval and GitHub proof tags were valid, causing pipeline stalls.

implementation.canonical_review_gate_ci: Implemented resolve_proof_tag_target with bounded peel depth (MAX_TAG_PEEL_DEPTH=5) verifying target commit against head_sha. Updated review_proof_tag_exists, operator_acceptance_proof_tag_exists, and reopen_proof_tag_exists. Updated build_status_payload to fail closed on reopen or conflicting tags.
implementation.github_review_bridge: Implemented _delete_ref and _resolve_ref_target_commit. Updated _push_review_proof_tag to delete opposing tags. Set _dispatch_canonical_review_gate_workflow default to required=True. Retired _submit_required_status and set mode='pull_request_review'.
implementation.auto_integrator: Implemented is_canonical_review_gate_green and make_integrator_tag_lookup. Added review gate re-dispatch reconciliation for valid TaskStore approvals with valid GitHub proof tags, returning action='waiting' while allowing independent candidates to proceed. Substantive test failures open ci-red.

review_decision.note: Ready for exact-head independent review by Codex.

runtime_activation.requires: Genuine assigned exact-head review, required checks and sole integrator merge before existing qualified runtime promotion.
